Paul Fornia is a Staff Data Scientist on the Security team at Stripe. He has over a decade of experience in machine learning, AI, and data science, with deep expertise in scam and fraud detection. Before Stripe, he spent nearly five years at Meta building anti-scam systems for WhatsApp and Facebook Marketplace, then founded BATLR.ai, a startup building a scam detection API for online platforms. Earlier in his career he worked in consulting, finance, and government, including at Deloitte, DataRobot, FINRA, and the Federal Reserve Board.

Paul graduated from the University of Colorado Boulder with degrees in Applied Math and Economics, Magna cum laude. He also holds a Masters degree in Computer Science from Johns Hopkins University.

Paul lives in Denver, CO, where he enjoys skiing, hiking, and backpacking.
